declarations.description:
Thin rule that divides content, horizontally or vertically, with an optional label in the middle ("or", a section
name). It is `role="separator"` for assistive technology unless marked `decorative`. Thickness, colour and line
style are variables, so dashed or dotted dividers, inset list dividers and accent rules are all one variable away.
declarations.name: Seperator

cssProperties.description: Margin on both sides across the line (above and below a horizontal rule).
cssProperties.name: --c2-seperator--spacing

cssProperties.description: Margin before the line along its axis, e.g. to align with list text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-seperator--inset-start

cssProperties.description: Margin after the line along its axis.
cssProperties.name: --c2-seperator--inset-end

cssProperties.description: Growth of the segment before the label; `0 0 16px` pins the label near the start.
cssProperties.name: --c2-seperator__line-start--flex

cssProperties.description: Growth of the segment after the label.
cssProperties.name: --c2-seperator__line-end--flex

cssProperties.description: Space between the label and the lines.
cssProperties.name: --c2-seperator__label--gap

slots.description: Optional label drawn between two line segments.

members.name: orientation
members.description: Direction of the line. A vertical seperator stretches to its flex row; give it a height elsewhere.

members.name: decorative
members.description: Purely visual: removes the `separator` role so screen readers skip it.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Direction of the line. A vertical seperator stretches to its flex row; give it a height elsewhere.

attributes.name: decorative
attributes.description: Purely visual: removes the `separator` role so screen readers skip it.
